answer_text:
Small agencies usually combine a CRM for new business with a project tool for delivery. Common choices:

1. Northwind CRM - the safe all-rounder: deep reporting and a large integration marketplace.
2. Pipewell Go - easy to adopt, but email features cost extra.
3. Brightdesk - capable, but the interface feels dated next to newer tools.

Trial Northwind CRM and Pipewell side by side with a real week of deals — the better fit is usually obvious by Friday.
